brief: The 5-product skincare routine that replaced my 14-step regimen.

slots.author: Olivia Wilson
slots.subtitle: FROM FOURTEEN STEPS DOWN TO ONLY FIVE

slots.author: Olivia Wilson
slots.title: THE FIVE STEP EDIT
slots.body: I used to layer fourteen products every night. My skin was overwhelmed and reactive. Now I rely on five essentials that deliver real results without the clutter.

slots.author: Olivia Wilson
slots.title: CLEANSING BALM
slots.body: Start with an oil-based balm to dissolve sunscreen and impurities. This single cleanse prepares your skin without stripping its natural barrier.

slots.author: Olivia Wilson
slots.title: HYDRATING TONER
slots.body: A weightless toner infused with hyaluronic acid restores moisture balance. It creates the perfect canvas for active ingredients to follow.

slots.author: Olivia Wilson
slots.title: VITAMIN C SERUM
slots.body: One potent antioxidant serum brightens dark spots and protects against daily environmental stress. I apply it every morning for visible luminosity.

slots.author: Olivia Wilson
slots.title: PEPTIDE MOISTURIZER
slots.body: A rich yet breathable cream locks in hydration and supports collagen. It replaces my former layering of essences, emulsions and night creams.

slots.author: Olivia Wilson
slots.title: MINERAL SUNSCREEN
slots.body: No routine is complete without protection from harmful rays. This final step prevents premature aging and keeps my complexion calm all day.
